remaining_limits: Finite holding/counter/recovery budgets; higher PPS or longer control outage can still lose packets.
Late ICMP remains; no one-second mobility guarantee.
Only sixteen noise IPs and two native Linux clients were tested; shared-NAT clients share untrusted candidate slots.
Spoofed leased tuples, source exhaustion and link saturation remain outside this protection.
IPv6, GUI clients, Internet DPI, full VM reboot and a long soak were not tested here.
Strict filtering removes I/J camouflage between A and B.
A wider receive window accepts older unseen authenticated counters; duplicate rejection and highest-counter endpoint selection remain.
Intermittent client-side QEMU/switch receive pauses remain a lab limitation.
